verdict.rationale: Hightouch has a built-in agent, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. The evidence only documents Hightouch running as an MCP server that external AI assistants connect to. Nothing shows the product connecting to or registering third-party MCP servers to use their tools, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
